title: In silico evaluation of the estrogenic activity of flavonoids from Butea monosperma: Exploring phytoestrogenic alternatives to endogenous estrogens.
one_liner_zh: 该研究用分子对接和MD模拟评估紫矿黄酮类化合物与雌激素受体ERα/ERβ的结合，属于蛋白-小分子互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且未涉及TF-DNA结合或AI/物理模拟方法创新，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Search for plant-based remedies for hypoestrogenism has validated the role of phytoestrogens as effective alternatives to endogenous estrogens. Extracts of Butea monosperma and its isolated metabolites have shown gynaecological effects pertaining to contraception, antifertility, anti-estrogenic and estrogenic potential as assessed by in vivo and in vitro assays. However, the molecular mechanism of interactions of these metabolites with estrogen receptors remains unexplored. To bridge this knowledge gap, the current research sought to characterize the pharmacological profile of flavonoids of this plant by an integrated computational approach. Twenty-nine compounds elaborated by the medicinal plant Butea monosperma were analysed for energy optimization using Guassian 16 software and taken up for molecular docking analysis by Schrodinger Maestro software and the binding affinity between the ligand and estrogenic receptors ER alpha - 1A52 and ER beta - 3OLS were analysed. Molecular dynamic trajectories and prime mmGBSA binding free energy calculations were evaluated for ligands selected from the binding interaction score. Qikprop software and the protox server predicted ADME characteristics and toxicity of the molecules respectively. The molecular docking analysis demonstrated that six compounds displayed docking affinities comparable to that of the endogenous ligand 17beta-estradiol at ER alpha, whereas fifteen compounds exhibited similar binding affinities at ER beta. Furthermore, five compounds exhibited stronger binding affinities than 17beta-estradiol toward ER alpha, while another five demonstrated enhanced binding affinities toward ER beta, suggesting their potential as more efficacious receptor ligands. The compound catechin and isocoreopsin exhibited glide energy of -40.035 kcal/mol and -49.11 kal/mol at ER alpha respectively whereas 17beta estradiol exhibited -52.012 kcal/mol. At ERbeta, catechin and butin exhibited appreciable glide energy. These compounds were found to interact with amino acid residues HIS524, GLU353, PHE404, PHE356 and ARG346 similar to that of 17beta estradiol. The study also revealed that chalcones and flavonols of Butea monosperma exhibit higher binding affinity to estrogenic receptors than the soy isoflavones genistein and daidzein.
abstract_zh: 针对低雌激素血症的植物疗法研究已证实，植物雌激素（phytoestrogens）作为内源性雌激素的有效替代品具有重要作用。紫矿（Butea monosperma）的提取物及其分离代谢物在体内和体外试验中显示出与避孕、抗生育、抗雌激素和雌激素潜力相关的妇科效应。然而，这些代谢物与雌激素受体相互作用的分子机制仍未探明。为填补这一知识空白，本研究旨在通过综合计算方法表征该植物黄酮类化合物的药理学特征。对药用植物紫矿产生的二十九种化合物使用Gaussian 16软件进行能量优化，并通过Schrodinger Maestro软件进行分子对接分析，评估配体与雌激素受体ER alpha - 1A52和ER beta - 3OLS之间的结合亲和力。对从结合相互作用评分中选出的配体进行了分子动力学轨迹和prime mmGBSA结合自由能计算。Qikprop软件和protox服务器分别预测了分子的ADME特性和毒性。分子对接分析表明，六种化合物在ER alpha处显示出与内源性配体17β-雌二醇相当的对接亲和力，而十五种化合物在ER beta处表现出相似的结合亲和力。此外，五种化合物对ER alpha表现出比17β-雌二醇更强的结合亲和力，另有五种对ER beta表现出增强的结合亲和力，表明它们作为更有效受体配体的潜力。化合物儿茶素（catechin）和异金鸡菊素（isocoreopsin）在ER alpha处的滑翔能分别为-40.035 kcal/mol和-49.11 kcal/mol，而17β-雌二醇为-52.012 kcal/mol。在ER beta处，儿茶素和紫矿因（butin）表现出可观的滑翔能。这些化合物被发现与氨基酸残基HIS524、GLU353、PHE404、PHE356和ARG346相互作用，与17β-雌二醇类似。研究还揭示，紫矿的查尔酮和黄酮醇对雌激素受体的结合亲和力高于大豆异黄酮染料木黄酮（genistein）和黄豆苷元（daidzein）。
